task.description: Enable building and running the user's OpenToonz fork from Visual Studio Code Insiders instead of the full Visual Studio IDE. The project is CMake-based; Visual Studio only ever consumed the CMake-generated solution. VS Code Insiders can drive the identical build through the CMake Tools extension and the same MSVC + Qt 5.15.2 toolchain, then launch/debug OpenToonz.exe with the C/C++ extension's Windows debugger (cppvsdbg). Deliverable: working .vscode config files plus a short how-to guide.

input.folder: Canonical build dir. Existing CMakeCache: generator "Visual Studio 18 2026", QT_PATH C:/Qt/5.15.2/msvc2019_64, Debug. Debug/ already has OpenToonz.exe + deployed Qt5*d.dll. Root CMake; RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = CMAKE_BINARY_DIR, so exe = toonz/build/Debug/OpenToonz.exe. Official Windows build doc (VS2019 + Qt5.15 + CMake, build dir toonz/build).

task.notes: Task profile: discovery Risk level: low Execution mode: standard-xml Execution autonomy: autonomous Approval mode: autonomous-gated Design guidance: not-needed Knowledge index: disabled Knowledge index backend: none Key facts from preliminary scan: CMake generator "Visual Studio 18 2026"; Qt at C:/Qt/5.15.2/msvc2019_64; canonical build dir is toonz/build (has deployed Qt DLLs next to exe); root build/ also exists but lacks deployed Qt DLLs so it is not used. Reuse toonz/build cache to avoid a full reconfigure.

phase.description: Confirm the build mechanism and the exact toolchain/paths VS Code must reuse.

steps.step: Scan repo: confirm CMake build, locate build dirs and generated exe.
Determine canonical build dir (toonz/build) and runtime exe path + Qt DLL location.
Decide to reuse existing toonz/build cache and the cppvsdbg debugger.

phase.review: Build mechanism and paths confirmed against on-disk cache and binaries.
phase.approval: Facts verified; safe to write configs.

phase.description: Create .vscode config so VS Code Insiders builds + runs OpenToonz one-click.

input.file: Extend with build dir + generator + QT_PATH.

steps.step: Update settings.json: cmake.buildDirectory=toonz/build, generator, configureSettings QT_PATH.
Create launch.json: cppvsdbg config launching CMake launch target, Qt bin on PATH.
Create tasks.json: CMake build task bound to the OpenToonz target.

phase.review: JSON valid; paths match real build dir and exe.
phase.approval: Configs reference existing cache and binaries correctly.

phase.description: Verify and document the workflow for the user.

steps.step: Validate all JSON parses and paths exist on disk.
Write short how-to guide (configure, build, run, debug).

output.folder: One-click build/run/debug config for VS Code Insiders.
